instructions:
Live and historical Bitcoin data from Bitview, read from a full node: on-chain metrics (MVRV, realized price, SOPR, holder cohorts, supply by age), blocks, transactions, addresses, mempool and fees, mining and difficulty, and the BTC/USD price, computed from the chain since 2015. Free and read-only, with no API key. Use of Bitview is under the terms at https://bitview.space/terms/; help is at https://bitview.space/support/.

For a series:

1. `search_series`: search by meaning with plain words; it returns series ids.
2. `get_series_info`: read a returned id's description, supported indexes, value type, unit (what the value type measures), accumulation (how its values combine over time), and the indexes whose values can be null (missing or undefined).
3. `get_series`, `get_series_latest`, `get_series_bulk`: pick one of those indexes and fetch its values (`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive), the latest value alone, or several comma-separated series at once.

Never invent a series id: only ids the API returned exist.

- `end` is exclusive: one block is start 900000, end 900001; one day is start 2025-01-01, end 2025-01-02.
- A `Ratio` or `Multiple` is a plain number (0.55, not 55%); a `Percent` is already a percent (55 means 55%).
- `null` means missing or undefined (before the data exists, or a period with no block), never zero.
- `price` reads 0, not null, before block 74,641 (August 2010): there was no price yet.
- Index names are exact (`day1`, not `day`); a wrong one is rejected with the valid list.
- The latest value is the newest one only, never a past one.
- Convert values only as asked.
- Compute derived numbers at full precision; round only the final answer, if at all.

Source of this data: Bitview (https://bitview.space). Binary responses are returned as embedded MCP resources.

---
name: bitview
description: "Fetches live and historical Bitcoin data from Bitview, read from a full node: on-chain metrics (MVRV, realized price, SOPR, holder cohorts, supply by age), blocks, transactions, addresses, mempool and fees, mining and difficulty, and the BTC/USD price, computed from the chain since 2015. Use when a question needs Bitcoin on-chain, market, mempool, fee, mining or holder-cohort data."
---

# Bitview

Bitcoin data from Bitview (https://bitview.space), read from a full node, through this MCP server's tools. Free and read-only, with no API key. Use of Bitview is under the terms at https://bitview.space/terms/; help is at https://bitview.space/support/.

## Series

31776 time series, each read at an index: `get_series` returns the values in `data` and their unit in `type`. `start`: Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optionally with a fraction of 1 to 9 digits before the Z). Negative integers count from end. `end`: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optionally with a fraction of 1 to 9 digits before the Z). Negative integers count from end.

Ids are snake_case metric names: request a likely one directly, as an unknown id returns 404 with the nearest ids and a wrong index 400 with the valid ones. Otherwise:

1. `search_series`: search by meaning with plain words; it returns series ids.
2. `get_series_info`: read a returned id's description, supported indexes, value type, unit (what the value type measures), accumulation (how its values combine over time), and the indexes whose values can be null (missing or undefined).
3. `get_series`, `get_series_latest`, `get_series_bulk`: pick one of those indexes and fetch its values (`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive), the latest value alone, or several comma-separated series at once.

Never invent a series id: only ids the API returned exist.

Indexes:

- Time buckets, UTC, `start`/`end` as dates or timestamps: `minute10` (10 minutes), `minute30` (30 minutes), `hour1` (1 hour), `hour4` (4 hours), `hour12` (12 hours), `day1` (1 day), `day3` (3 days), `week1` (1 week), `month1` (1 month), `month3` (3 months), `month6` (6 months), `year1` (1 year), `year10` (10 years).
- Positions (block height, epoch, transaction, input, output, or address of a type), `start`/`end` as integers: `halving_epoch`, `difficulty_epoch`, `height`, `tx_index`, `txin_index`, `txout_index`, `empty_script_output_index`, `op_return_output_index`, `p2a_address_index`, `p2ms_output_index`, `p2pk33_address_index`, `p2pk65_address_index`, `p2pkh_address_index`, `p2sh_address_index`, `p2tr_address_index`, `p2wpkh_address_index`, `p2wsh_address_index`, `unknown_script_output_index`.

Traps:

- `end` is exclusive: one block is start 900000, end 900001; one day is start 2025-01-01, end 2025-01-02.
- A `Ratio` or `Multiple` is a plain number (0.55, not 55%); a `Percent` is already a percent (55 means 55%).
- `null` means missing or undefined (before the data exists, or a period with no block), never zero.
- `price` reads 0, not null, before block 74,641 (August 2010): there was no price yet.
- Index names are exact (`day1`, not `day`); a wrong one is rejected with the valid list.
- The latest value is the newest one only, never a past one.
- Convert values only as asked.
- Compute derived numbers at full precision; round only the final answer, if at all.

## Other tools

- Server: `get_sync_status`
- Series: `get_series_count`, `list_indexes`, `list_series`, `get_series_len`, `get_series_version`
- General: `get_difficulty_adjustment`, `get_prices`, `get_historical_price`
- Addresses: `get_address_hash_prefix_matches`, `get_address`, `get_address_txs`, `get_address_confirmed_txs`, `get_address_confirmed_txs_after`, `get_address_mempool_txs`, `get_address_utxos`, `validate_address`
- Blocks: `get_block`, `get_block_v1`, `get_block_header`, `get_block_hash_by_height`, `get_block_by_timestamp`, `get_block_status`, `get_block_tip_height`, `get_block_tip_hash`, `get_block_txid`, `get_block_txs_from_index`, `get_blocks`, `get_blocks_from_height`, `get_blocks_v1`, `get_blocks_v1_from_height`
- Mining: `get_block_audit_summary`, `get_block_audit`, `get_block_audit_score`, `get_recent_audit_scores`, `get_audit_scores`, `get_audit_predictions`, `get_transaction_audit`, `get_pools`, `get_pool_ranking`, `get_pool`, `get_pools_hashrate_by_period`, `get_pool_hashrate`, `get_pool_blocks`, `get_pool_blocks_from_height`, `get_hashrate_by_period`, `get_difficulty_adjustments_by_period`, `get_reward_stats`, `get_block_fees`, `get_block_rewards`, `get_block_fee_rates_precise`, `get_block_sizes_weights`
- Fees: `get_mempool_blocks`, `get_precise_fees`
- Mempool: `get_mempool`, `get_mempool_recent`, `get_replacements`, `get_fullrbf_replacements`
- Transactions: `get_txid_by_index`, `get_cpfp`, `get_tx_rbf`, `get_tx`, `get_tx_hex`, `get_tx_merkleblock_proof`, `get_tx_merkle_proof`, `get_tx_outspend`, `get_tx_outspends`, `get_tx_status`, `get_transaction_times`
- UTXO Set: `get_utxo_set_diff`
- URPD: `list_urpd_cohorts`, `get_urpd_latest`, `get_urpd`

What each does and takes: `references/endpoints.md`.

# Bitview tools

Every tool, with its arguments (`*` required). Each tool's description says what it returns.

- `get_sync_status` Sync status
- `get_series_count` Series count
- `list_indexes` List available indexes
- `list_series` Series list. Arguments: `q`, `page`, `per_page`
- `search_series` Search series. Arguments: `q`*, `limit`
- `get_series_info` Get series info. Arguments: `series`*
- `get_series` Get series data. Arguments: `series`*, `index`*, `start`, `end`, `limit`, `format`
- `get_series_latest` Get latest series value. Arguments: `series`*, `index`*
- `get_series_len` Get series data length. Arguments: `series`*, `index`*
- `get_series_version` Get series version. Arguments: `series`*, `index`*
- `get_series_bulk` Bulk series data. Arguments: `series`*, `index`*, `start`, `end`, `limit`, `format`
- `list_urpd_cohorts` Available URPD cohorts
- `get_urpd_latest` Latest URPD. Arguments: `cohort`*, `agg`, `weight`
- `get_urpd` URPD at block height or date. Arguments: `cohort`*, `point`*, `agg`, `weight`
- `get_difficulty_adjustment` Difficulty adjustment
- `get_prices` Current BTC price
- `get_historical_price` Historical price. Arguments: `timestamp`, `currency`
- `get_address_hash_prefix_matches` Address hash-prefix matches. Arguments: `address_type`*, `prefix`*
- `get_address` Address information. Arguments: `address`*
- `get_address_txs` Address transactions. Arguments: `address`*, `after_txid`, `max_txs`
- `get_address_confirmed_txs` Address confirmed transactions. Arguments: `address`*, `max_txs`
- `get_address_confirmed_txs_after` Address confirmed transactions (paginated). Arguments: `address`*, `after_txid`*, `max_txs`
- `get_address_mempool_txs` Address mempool transactions. Arguments: `address`*, `max_txs`
- `get_address_utxos` Address UTXOs. Arguments: `address`*
- `validate_address` Validate address. Arguments: `address`*
- `get_block` Block information. Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_block_v1` Block (v1). Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_block_header` Block header. Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_block_hash_by_height` Block hash by height. Arguments: `height`*
- `get_block_by_timestamp` Block by timestamp. Arguments: `timestamp`*
- `get_block_status` Block status. Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_block_tip_height` Block tip height
- `get_block_tip_hash` Block tip hash
- `get_block_txid` Transaction ID at index. Arguments: `hash`*, `index`*
- `get_block_txs_from_index` Block transactions (paginated). Arguments: `hash`*, `start_index`*
- `get_blocks` Recent blocks
- `get_blocks_from_height` Blocks from height. Arguments: `height`*
- `get_blocks_v1` Recent blocks with extras
- `get_blocks_v1_from_height` Blocks from height with extras. Arguments: `height`*
- `get_block_audit_summary` This server's recorded block expectation. Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_block_audit` Recorded missing, fresh, conflicting, added and unseen transactions. Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_block_audit_score` Recorded audit score for a block hash. Arguments: `hash`*
- `get_recent_audit_scores` Audited scores in the latest sixteen height slots
- `get_audit_scores` Audited scores through a canonical height. Arguments: `height`*
- `get_audit_predictions` Time-bucketed canonical audit match rates. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_transaction_audit` How this server's expectation classified a confirmed transaction. Arguments: `hash`*, `txid`*
- `get_pools` List all mining pools
- `get_pool_ranking` Mining pool statistics. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_pool` Mining pool details. Arguments: `slug`*
- `get_pools_hashrate_by_period` All pools hashrate. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_pool_hashrate` Mining pool hashrate. Arguments: `slug`*
- `get_pool_blocks` Mining pool blocks. Arguments: `slug`*
- `get_pool_blocks_from_height` Mining pool blocks before height. Arguments: `slug`*, `height`*
- `get_hashrate_by_period` Network hashrate. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_difficulty_adjustments_by_period` Difficulty adjustments. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_reward_stats` Mining reward statistics. Arguments: `block_count`*
- `get_block_fees` Block fees. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_block_rewards` Block rewards. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_block_fee_rates_precise` Block fee rates (precise). Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_block_sizes_weights` Block sizes and weights. Arguments: `time_period`*
- `get_mempool_blocks` Projected mempool blocks
- `get_precise_fees` Recommended fee rates (precise)
- `get_mempool` Mempool statistics
- `get_mempool_recent` Recent mempool transactions
- `get_replacements` Recent RBF replacements
- `get_fullrbf_replacements` Recent full-RBF replacements
- `get_txid_by_index` Txid by index. Arguments: `index`*
- `get_cpfp` CPFP info. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx_rbf` RBF replacement history. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx` Transaction information. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx_hex` Transaction hex. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx_merkleblock_proof` Transaction merkleblock proof. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx_merkle_proof` Transaction merkle proof. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx_outspend` Output spend status. Arguments: `txid`*, `vout`*
- `get_tx_outspends` All output spend statuses. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_tx_status` Transaction status. Arguments: `txid`*
- `get_transaction_times` Transaction first-seen times. Arguments: `txids`*
- `get_utxo_set_diff` UTXO set changes of a block or date. Arguments: `point`*

tool.name: get_address
tool.title: Address information
tool.description: Bitcoin: Balance and transaction counts. Supports P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR and P2A addresses, and P2PK public keys in hex (33 or 65 bytes).

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_address_confirmed_txs
tool.title: Address confirmed transactions
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get the newest confirmed transactions for an address, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most). For pagination, request `get_address_confirmed_txs_after` with the last returned txid.

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 25 (the default); larger values return 25.

tool.name: get_address_confirmed_txs_after
tool.title: Address confirmed transactions (paginated)
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get the next confirmed transactions strictly older than `after_txid`, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most); a txid outside the address's history answers `[]` (Esplora-canonical pagination form, matches mempool.space).

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

after_txid.description: Last txid from the previous page (return transactions strictly older than this)

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 25 (the default); larger values return 25.

tool.name: get_address_hash_prefix_matches
tool.title: Address hash-prefix matches
tool.description: Bitcoin: Find addresses by address type and by the first 1-16 hex nibbles of RapidHash v3 over the raw address payload bytes. Intended for privacy-preserving client-side wallet discovery without sending raw addresses or xpubs. Fetch metadata with `get_address`.

address_type.description: The output type of an address: any output type but `p2ms`, `op_return`, `empty_script` and `unknown_script`.

prefix.description:
First 1–16 hexadecimal nibbles of the RapidHash v3 hash over the raw
address payload bytes.

tool.name: get_address_mempool_txs
tool.title: Address mempool transactions
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get unconfirmed transactions for an address from the mempool, newest first, up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most).

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 50 (the default); larger values return 50.

tool.name: get_address_txs
tool.title: Address transactions
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get transaction history for an address, newest first: up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most), mempool transactions first and confirmed ones filling the rest. To continue, pass the last returned txid as `after_txid`, or request `get_address_confirmed_txs_after` for confirmed history.

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

after_txid.description:
Continue after this transaction, a mempool or a confirmed one: the older ones (a confirmed
cursor skips the mempool). One that is neither answers 422.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 50 (the default); larger values return 50.

tool.name: get_address_utxos
tool.title: Address UTXOs
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for an address, including unconfirmed ones; outputs that mempool transactions spend are left out.

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_audit_predictions
tool.title: Time-bucketed canonical audit match rates
tool.description: Bitcoin: Time-bucketed canonical audit match rates

tool.name: get_audit_scores
tool.title: Audited scores through a canonical height
tool.description: Bitcoin: Audited scores through a canonical height

height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_block
tool.title: Block information
tool.description: Bitcoin: Details of a block by hash: height, time, transaction count, size, weight, and difficulty.

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_audit
tool.title: Recorded missing, fresh, conflicting, added and unseen transactions
tool.description: Bitcoin: Recorded missing, fresh, conflicting, added and unseen transactions

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_audit_score
tool.title: Recorded audit score for a block hash
tool.description: Bitcoin: A permanent server-local score. A missing audit returns the JSON string "null".

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_audit_summary
tool.title: This server's recorded block expectation
tool.description: Bitcoin: This server's recorded block expectation

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_by_timestamp
tool.title: Block by timestamp
tool.description: Bitcoin: Find the block with the greatest header timestamp at or before the given UNIX timestamp, choosing the earliest height on ties.

tool.name: get_block_fee_rates_precise
tool.title: Block fee rates (precise)
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get block fee rate percentiles (min, 10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th, max) for a time period, each in sat/vB to 3 decimals.

tool.name: get_block_fees
tool.title: Block fees
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get average total fees per block for a time period.

tool.name: get_block_hash_by_height
tool.title: Block hash by height
tool.description: Bitcoin: Block hash as plain text.

height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_block_header
tool.title: Block header
tool.description: Bitcoin: Returns the hex-encoded 80-byte block header.

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_rewards
tool.title: Block rewards
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get average coinbase reward (subsidy + fees) per block for a time period.

tool.name: get_block_sizes_weights
tool.title: Block sizes and weights
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get average block sizes and weights for a time period.

tool.name: get_block_status
tool.title: Block status
tool.description: Bitcoin: Whether the block is in the best chain and, if so, its height and the hash of the next block. A block outside the best chain (orphaned or unknown) reports `in_best_chain: false`.

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_tip_hash
tool.title: Block tip hash
tool.description: Bitcoin: Hash of the latest block.

tool.name: get_block_tip_height
tool.title: Block tip height
tool.description: Bitcoin: Height of the latest block.

tool.name: get_block_txid
tool.title: Transaction ID at index
tool.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve a single transaction ID at a specific index within a block. Returns plain text txid.

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_txs_from_index
tool.title: Block transactions (paginated)
tool.description: Bitcoin: Up to 25 transactions starting at `start_index`, a multiple of 25.

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

start_index.description: Starting transaction index within the block (0-based)

tool.name: get_block_v1
tool.title: Block (v1)
tool.description: Bitcoin: Returns block details with extras by hash.

hash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_blocks
tool.title: Recent blocks
tool.description: Bitcoin: The last 10 blocks.

tool.name: get_blocks_from_height
tool.title: Blocks from height
tool.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve up to 10 blocks going backwards from the given height. For example, height=100 returns blocks 100, 99, 98, ..., 91. Height=0 returns only block 0. A height past the tip is not found.

height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_blocks_v1
tool.title: Recent blocks with extras
tool.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve the last 15 blocks with extended data including pool identification and fee statistics.

tool.name: get_blocks_v1_from_height
tool.title: Blocks from height with extras
tool.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve up to 15 blocks with extended data going backwards from the given height: the published blocks among the 15 heights ending at it, so fewer (or none) past the tip.

height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_cpfp
tool.title: CPFP info
tool.description: Bitcoin: Returns ancestors and descendants for a CPFP (Child Pays For Parent) transaction, including the effective fee rate of the package. A mempool transaction answers its live package; a confirmed one its package among its block's transactions; an unknown transaction, or a confirmed one without relatives in its block, `{"ancestors":[]}`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustment
tool.title: Difficulty adjustment
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get current difficulty adjustment progress and estimates. Every field is computed from the chain alone, so the answer changes only with a new block: elapsed time is measured to the tip block, and `estimatedRetargetDate` is the tip block's time plus `remainingTime`, where mempool.space counts both from its clock. That date is early by the tip's age and, with a block or two left in the epoch, can be before now; add `remainingTime` to your own clock for a date counted from now.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustments_by_period
tool.title: Difficulty adjustments
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get historical difficulty adjustments for a time period.

tool.name: get_fullrbf_replacements
tool.title: Recent full-RBF replacements
tool.description: Bitcoin: Same response shape as `get_replacements`, but limited to trees where at least one predecessor was non-signaling (full-RBF).

tool.name: get_hashrate_by_period
tool.title: Network hashrate
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get network hashrate and difficulty data for a time period.

tool.name: get_historical_price
tool.title: Historical price
tool.description: Bitcoin: Completed four-hour BTC/USD closes, newest first as mempool.space lists them, labeled by interval end, from the first priced interval (2010-08-16). With a UNIX timestamp, returns the latest nonempty completed close at or before it; before the first close returns an empty list. The current partial interval is excluded. USD only (`currency` accepts `USD`); exchangeRates is empty.

timestamp.description: UNIX timestamp: the latest close at or before it

currency.description: Quote currency: USD, the only one served

tool.name: get_mempool
tool.title: Mempool statistics
tool.description: Bitcoin: Current mempool backlog: transaction count, total virtual size, total fees, and fee histogram.

tool.name: get_mempool_blocks
tool.title: Projected mempool blocks
tool.description: Bitcoin: Projected blocks for fee estimation, up to eight as mempool.space's. Every block, block 0 the next, is packed as Core's block assembler packs (whole CPFP chunks by feerate, in dependency order, within Core's default weight and sigop budgets), ranked by the node's signed modified fees (including `prioritisetransaction`), with paid fees in the statistics. The last holds whatever is left: more than a block when the mempool is busy. `GET /api/mempool-blocks/{index}` serves each with its transactions, except such a last one.

tool.name: get_mempool_recent
tool.title: Recent mempool transactions
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get the last 10 transactions to enter the mempool.

tool.name: get_pool
tool.title: Mining pool details
tool.description: Bitcoin: Block counts and mining shares by time period for one pool.

slug.description: A mining pool's slug, as written in URLs: `get_pools` lists them.

tool.name: get_pool_blocks
tool.title: Mining pool blocks
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get up to 100 recent blocks mined by a specific pool.

slug.description: A mining pool's slug, as written in URLs: `get_pools` lists them.

tool.name: get_pool_blocks_from_height
tool.title: Mining pool blocks before height
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get up to 100 blocks mined by a specific pool strictly below the given height (pass the last height of a page to get the next one).

slug.description: A mining pool's slug, as written in URLs: `get_pools` lists them.

height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_pool_hashrate
tool.title: Mining pool hashrate
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get hashrate history for a specific mining pool.

slug.description: A mining pool's slug, as written in URLs: `get_pools` lists them.

tool.name: get_pool_ranking
tool.title: Mining pool statistics
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get mining pool statistics for a time period.

tool.name: get_pools
tool.title: List all mining pools
tool.description: Bitcoin: Every known mining pool.

tool.name: get_pools_hashrate_by_period
tool.title: All pools hashrate
tool.description: Bitcoin: Get weekly hashrate data, for a time period, of the mining pools that mined in the last week, by time and then their weekly rank.

tool.name: get_precise_fees
tool.title: Recommended fee rates (precise)
tool.description: Bitcoin: Recommended fee rates by confirmation target, with up to three decimal places and support for sub-sat/vB rates.

tool.name: get_prices
tool.title: Current BTC price
tool.description: Bitcoin: Returns bitcoin latest price (on-chain derived, USD only).

tool.name: get_recent_audit_scores
tool.title: Audited scores in the latest sixteen height slots
tool.description: Bitcoin: Audited scores in the latest sixteen height slots

tool.name: get_replacements
tool.title: Recent RBF replacements
tool.description: Bitcoin: Returns up to 25 most-recent RBF replacement trees across the whole mempool. Each entry has the shape of `replacements` in `get_tx_rbf`.

tool.name: get_series
tool.title: Get series data
tool.description: Bitcoin: History of an on-chain metric, by the series id from `search_series`: rows selected by a range of positions, dates or timestamps, as JSON or CSV.

end.description: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optionally with a fraction of 1 to 9 digits before the Z). Negative integers count from end.

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return; with `end` too, the tighter of the two applies. Omitted, the rest of the range.

tool.name: get_series_bulk

series.description:

Deserialization permits at most 32 names, each exact, and 2,048 decoded input

tool.name: get_urpd
tool.title: URPD at block height or date
tool.description: Bitcoin: URPD (UTXO realized price distribution: how much supply last moved at each price) for a cohort at a block height or the last block of a UTC day. Returns `{ height, hash, date, cohort, weight, aggregation, close, supply, buckets }` where `buckets` is columns, `{ price, supply, realized_cap, unrealized_pnl }`, one entry per bucket in ascending price: the same block header and columnar layout as `GET /api/utxo-set/{point}`. `close`, `price`, `realized_cap`, and `unrealized_pnl` are USD; `supply` is BTC. `unrealized_pnl` can be negative. Bucket `realized_cap` and `unrealized_pnl` value each coin at its creation price on the price grid (four significant digits of the price in cents, within 0.05% of the exact price), rounded to the cent per bucket, so the buckets need not sum to the realized cap series. With a `wakefulness` or `mobility` `weight`, `supply` is the weighted supply (whole satoshis) and the bucket values follow it.

cohort.description: A URPD cohort, by its series' prefix: an age aggregate (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...) or an age band (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

point.description: Confirmed block height (`840000`) or UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_urpd_latest
tool.title: Latest URPD
tool.description: Bitcoin: URPD (UTXO realized price distribution: how much supply last moved at each price) for the latest published block; `date` echoes the date served. Fields, units, price-grid rounding and weighting as in `get_urpd`.

cohort.description: A URPD cohort, by its series' prefix: an age aggregate (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...) or an age band (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

tool.name: get_utxo_set_diff
tool.title: UTXO set changes of a block or date
tool.description: Bitcoin: What a block (`840000`) or a UTC day's published blocks (`YYYY-MM-DD`) changed in the UTXO set. Returns `{ first, last, hash, date, created, spent }`: `created` has one row per block, `spent` one row per creation height, each as columnar `height`, `count` and `supply` (BTC). The set after block `first - 1` plus `created` minus `spent` is the set after block `last`.

point.description: Confirmed block height (`840000`) or UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: list_indexes
tool.title: List available indexes
tool.description: Bitcoin: Returns every index a series can be read at, by the name series routes take.

tool.name: list_series
tool.title: Series list
tool.description: Bitcoin: Paginated flat list of the available series names: all of them, or with `q` only those that contain that text as written (a plain match, unlike `search_series`; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes).

q.description: Only the names that contain this text, as written: no words, case folding or wildcards (default: every name)

tool.name: list_urpd_cohorts
tool.title: Available URPD cohorts
tool.description: Bitcoin: Every URPD cohort once a UTXO set is published (none before): the age aggregates (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...), then the age bands from the youngest (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

tool.name: search_series
tool.title: Search series
tool.description: Bitcoin: Find on-chain metrics by plain words: MVRV, realized price, SOPR, NUPL, supply held by long-term or short-term holders, coin age, addresses by balance, hashrate, fees, volume, and thousands more. Start here for any metric question: it returns the series ids to pass to `get_series_latest` or `get_series`. Results prioritize whole query words in names, then names matching every word by its start, joined words or a plural, then descriptions holding every word whole, singular or plural (never a part of a word or a typo), then names with a typo. Word order does not matter. Descriptions provide cohort terminology and formulas. The decoded q parameter is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

q.description: Words to find in series names and descriptions (`realized price`, `mvrv`), in any order

tool.name: validate_address
tool.title: Validate address
tool.description: Bitcoin: Validate a Bitcoin address and get information about its type and scriptPubKey. Returns `isvalid: false` with an error message for invalid addresses; a string that isn't 2 to 130 letters and digits answers 400.

address.description:
Bitcoin address to validate: 2 to 130 letters and digits (a P2PK public key in hex is 130);
anything else answers 400, as mempool.space does
